personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 4 Tactile components (Heavy branding, bold pill buttons, chunky radiuses 24-30 dictated by brand guidelines)
personality_one_liner: A professional and confident on-demand services CRM that feels both robustly corporate yet highly approachable through tactile, rounded components.

spacing.rule: Avoid cramming elements. Use lg and xl for card paddings and outer margins, honoring the thick rounded aesthetics requested.

do's: Keep standard solid corporate containers and thick border colors as requested.
dont's: Do not use blur over images; use the explicitly requested white gradient fade to the left for the hero image

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Client entry point to request quotes and browse services or call emergencies.
screens.layout: Header #002B55 with centered logo + white hamburger menu right. Hero section: white with rounded bottom corners, right-aligned image blended via gradient to left. Title #001D3D 900 italic. Full width primary CTA #FFCC00. 'Nuestros servicios' block #002B55 background, 2x2 grid white cards with border-radius 22. 'Urgencias 24h' block #FFF7F5 background, 4px red border, border-radius 30, containing 2 columns of action buttons.

screens.name: Confirmation
screens.purpose: To confirm quote request receipt and explain next steps to the user.
screens.layout: Header #001D3D with back chevron left and menu right. White block with right-aligned decorative room image faded to white left, green success circle centered. Title #071B35 900. Info summary card #E3F0FF radius 24 with #CFDCE9 row dividers. 'Next steps' info card #FFF3CD radius 24. Two full-width pill buttons at bottom.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level KPI overview and quick access for company management.
screens.layout: Use solid colored summary cards (#E3F0FF and #FFF3CD) displaying active workers, pending quotes, and profitability metrics. Utilize clear spacing and strong typographic hierarchy using Montserrat.

hero_living_room.alt: Bright modern living room under renovation with beige sofa, ladder, toolbox

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the user's color tokens: Corporate blue (#002B55), Main yellow accents (#FFCC00), Urgent red (#BD0000), Success green (#00AA27).
Use 'Montserrat' (Black/ExtraBold 900, sometimes italic) for the logo mark, titles and high-impact headings. Use 'Inter' for body texts.
Implement thick rounded corners precisely as requested (radius 22 for service cards, radius 24 for summary cards, radius 30 for the urgent block).
In the Hero and Confirmation screens, the background image on the right must seamlessly blend with a white gradient towards the left text area.
The Bottom navigation must be fixed #001D3D with Active tabs in #FFCC00 and yellow underline. It should also include a hamburger drawer to switch the 'Modo / Rol Actual'.

All icons must use Lucide (e.g. file-text, chevron-right, droplets, zap, paint-roller, brick-wall, siren, phone, send, house, wrench, clipboard-list, user-round, calendar-days, map-pin, circle-plus, info, check).
Role switches except for Client must be protected by a 4-digit PIN.
